separateRuntimeBug.name: pending-lethal-source-lost-on-paused-draw
separateRuntimeBug.mechanism: Both body systems overwrite the previously drawn living HP/visibility on an empty-effect paused draw while the real lethal effect is still in state.effects. Resume then receives the real event without its prior living witness.
separateRuntimeBug.fix: Read-only guard retains an already drawn living witness only while the unique real lethal event remains queued. Only the normal delivered effect can create the original one-copy death remnant. Empty/cleared queue, replaced owner, new scene/dead first draw and reduced delivery cannot invent a death.
